Topic: Graphical Analysis with FTC

How well did the responses address the course content related to this question? How well did the 
responses integrate the skill(s) required on this question? 

Part (a) 

• 
Most responses indicated at least a proficient understanding of the properties of definite integrals. These responses 
correctly used geometry to evaluate g(4) and g(6 .) 

• 
The most common mistake in this part was in failing to recognize that g(−6) was the negative of the area of region 

R.
